sentence: The temperature fell 16 degrees in just under half an hour.
synonym: dropped 16 degrees in less than thirty minutes
synonymNote: 两者都表示温度在不到半小时内下降了16度，意思相同。

distractors.word: rose 16 degrees in just under half an hour
distractors.note: rose表示上升，与fell的下降意思相反。

distractors.word: stayed 16 degrees for just under half an hour
distractors.note: stayed表示保持不变，不是下降的意思。

distractors.word: fell 16 degrees in more than half an hour
distractors.note: 时间描述改变了，超过半小时与原意不符。
